s0.body: The WS operations ecosystem — designed, built and run in-house.

s2.headline: It starts with the take-off.
s2.body: Measured quantities from CostX become the working estimate — rates, margins and the pricing engine stay strictly in-house.

s3.headline:
One spreadsheet in.
A signed quote out.
chips: White-label web quote — the client's brand up top
Matching branded PDF, three design themes
Two-party e-signature with a tamper-evident audit trail
Sent by WhatsApp: spreadsheet in, live link back
s3.title: Facade Package — WS0657

s4.label: projects catalogued — every quote in the drive, numbered and flagged
s4.wonChip: Won jobs flagged · real project numbers on the website
s4.tokenNote: — one number threads the schedule, the geofence and the invoice

s5.headline: The COO plans the week. The system carries it.
s5.body: Every task on the self-hosted Gantt syncs to the shared work_day table every 15 minutes — and lands on each worker’s phone as “My day”.

s6.kicker: Stage 05 · GeoClock · WST034 Field Time Clock
s6.headline: Hours validated at the site fence.
s6.body: GPS clock-in tied to real project numbers. Web tap, native geofence or WhatsApp — every event passes through one server-validated /clock endpoint, and every attempt is logged.
chips: 184 project sites geofenced — circle and polygon
Auto clock-in on arrival, clock-out on leaving

s7.headline: One app for every worker.
features: installable on any phone; a 5.8 MB Capacitor shell wraps the live crew.wssoltech.au
Portuguese first, English always one tap away
live on Android: arrive on site and the shift starts itself
site diary, materials, equipment, incidents — and a signed tax invoice at week’s end
